Name: Astarion Heart Events
Author: kokiriforest0617
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20362]WhisperWillow's Baldur's Valley - BG3 Replacement Mod[/url] added in our lovely Astarion to Stardew Valley with dialogue updates- this mod overhauls Elliott's heart events to be more specific to our favorite vampire!

I've shuffled around how many hearts are needed for some of the vanilla cutscenes, updated a lot of the dialogue, and added in some new cutscenes for good measure. I tried to make it flow similarly to BG3- but toned down to be Stardew Valley level stakes. (instead of world-ending mindflayer invasion stakes). Still, bear in mind that this will include spoilers for BG3 content/content that was pulled directly from BG3's cutscences. 

Because I like Astarion [s]an unhinged[/s] a completely normal amount: I also lost my head a little and added a lot of extra dialogue to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20362]WhisperWillow's original mod[/url] to include more of my personal favorite Astarion lines from BG3, Neil's streams, and fanfiction... with a sprinkling of a Hozier lyric or two (Can I help it if Hozier writes lyrics suited a 100-year-old vampire?)

You can add in just the heart events to the original mod or feel free to take both the heart events and dialogue updates. Keep in mind this includes some swearing and the occasional suggestive flirty comment. 

TW: Mentions of abuse during one of the heart events: [spoiler]When Astarion is telling you about Cazador during the 6 heart event.[/spoiler]

[u][b]Installation
[/b][/u][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20362]WhisperWillow's original mod[/url]
[*]Download ONLY ONE of the files- either just Astarion Heart Events Only (if you want to keep the original dialogue) or Astarion Hearts Events and Expanded Dialogue (if you want my personal dialogue updates)
[*]Copy my mod's content.json file AND the Data folder
[*]Paste the content file and the data folder from my mod into WhisperWillow's Mod
[*]Get in there and romance that vampire.
[/list]
[b]Note: [/b]In the screenshots, I'm using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21312]Astarion Replacement Portrait[/url] Mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52845636]GlitchedinOrbit
[/url]
Big shout out to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Luminiari/]Luminiari[/url] for helping me edit for punctuation and grammar! 
[u]
